text:
frank: Quick huddle — Composer launch plan. We're A/B testing credit allocation (+prompt pack) and headline messaging. Goal: measure 7-day activation (first success + return). Need owners for copy variants, analytics schema, and webinar routing.
olivia: I'll draft 3 short post variants and a 3-email webinar nurture. Short CTA prefers "Save my seat" per past lift. I'll also create a micro landing with auto-apply credits link.
diane: Analytics events: signup_path, composer_cohort, credit_bucket, prompt_kit_id, gen_success_first, session_two_return, nudge_shown, activation_7d. Payload example:
```
{ "uid": "...", "composer_cohort": "C_beta_200", "credit_bucket": 200 }
```
Add flag composer_exposed=true on user object.
matt: Cohorts: alpha_50 (50 + starter), beta_200 (200 + curated), control. Randomize deterministically by user_id hash, target 3k total (1800/600/600). Segment by source: docs, blog, social, webinar. Primary KPI = activation_7d; secondary = avg tokens week1 and second-session rate.
frank: Copy drafts (two variants):
- Punchy: "Composer is live — get instant credits and starter prompts to prototype LLM features. Live demo & tips in our webinar. -> [link]"
- Contextual: "Prototype product-grade LLM features fast with Composer: free credits + curated prompt packs. Join our kickoff webinar for real examples. -> [link]"
olivia: Use UTM template: utm_campaign=composer_launch_26&utm_source=post&utm_medium=social. For webinar signups route crm.tag=lead:webinar and enroll in 3-email nurture. Use CTA text "Reserve my seat" on long-form placements.
diane: I'll push schema by Tue EOD and add experiment flags by Thu morning. I'll include boolean and enum credit_tier values: low50, med200, control.
matt: I'll drop allocation script and sampling validation in repo by Wed. Will also create a simple dashboard: 7-day activation funnel, tokens per activated user, cohort comparisons.
ops-bot: Campaign record marketing::composer_launch_26 created, reminder scheduled at 4100010000.
frank: Action list — @diane schema + flags (Tue EOD), @olivia finalize copy + email pack (Wed noon), @matt sampling & dashboard (Wed EOD), @frank wire landing + creatives (Wed EOD). Run window 14 days, snapshot at day 7 for primary benchmark (activation_7d, tokens_week1, retention D14). Thanks — dropping the brief in Drive and will ping when assets live. :rocket:
